methods.label: Find each session's time
methods.explanation:
An hour has \(60\) minutes. Dividing \(60\) by the speed in miles per hour gives the minutes needed for one mile. Each session covers \(2\) miles, so the session times in minutes are
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{Monday: }&2\cdot(60\div5)=24,\\
\text{Wednesday: }&2\cdot(60\div3)=40,\\
\text{Friday: }&2\cdot(60\div4)=30.
\end{aligned}
\]
His actual total was \(24+40+30=94\) minutes.

At \(4\) miles per hour, every session would take \(30\) minutes, giving \(3\cdot30=90\) minutes altogether. He would therefore spend \(94-90=4\) minutes less on the treadmill, choice D.
